name: Laongo granite sculpture site
subtitle: Laongo is an open-air granite sculpture site about 35 km north-east of Ouagadougou, in Oubritenga Province.

facts.label: Province
facts.value: In Oubritenga Province, whose capital is Ziniaré

facts.label: Origin
facts.value: Initiative of the Comité National des Arts Plastiques du Burkina; first symposium held 13 January to 2 March 1989

facts.label: Precedents
facts.value: At its creation in 1989 only two other such sites existed, in Spain and the United States

facts.label: Works (initiator, 2018)
facts.value: More than 300 sculptures; the initiator says a second site also exists

facts.label: Former land use
facts.value: Site formerly reserved for farming and herding

facts.label: Funding limits
facts.value: Initiator says a biennial exhibition has not been possible since 1989 for lack of funds and external funding

facts.label: First symposium name
facts.value: First held in 1989 as the symposium 'Sympo granit 89'

parts.text: Laongo is an open-air granite sculpture site about 35 km north-east of Ouagadougou, in Oubritenga Province. It began with an international symposium held from 13 January to 2 March 1989, organised by the Comité National des Arts Plastiques du Burkina. The site covers more than 75 hectares and holds more than 200 works according to a 2025 academic study, or more than 300 according to its initiator in 2018.
